meaning: Gas mass fraction of the inflow gas+oil mixture. Specify -1 for OLGA to use the equilibrium values from the PVT table.
Mass fraction of total water in the total boundary fluid mixture. Use -1 for the total water fraction to be taken from the PVT table. Either this key or WATERFRACTION can be specified.
Mass fraction of free water in the total boundary fluid mixture. Either this key or TOTALWATERFRACTION can be specified.
